```html
<x-livewire-component :title="'Create Link'" :description="'Add a new link to your website.'" class="bg-white shadow-lg rounded-md p-4">
    <form wire:submit.prevent="storeLink">
        <div class="mb-4">
            <label for="link" class="block text-gray-700 font-bold mb-2">Link URL</label>
            <input type="text" id="link" name="link" wire:model="link" class="shadow-sm border rounded-md py-3 px-4 focus:outline-none">
        </div>
        <div class="mb-4">
            <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-md">Create Link</button>
        </div>
    </form>

    @if ($errors->any())
        <div class="text-red-500 mt-4">
            @foreach ($errors as $error)
                {{ $error }}<br>
            @endforeach
        </div>
    @endif

    @if (session('success'))
        <div class="text-green-500 mt-4">
            {{ session('success') }}
        </div>
    @endif
</x-livewire-component>
```
